WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(length) AS avg_length,
         AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND rating IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length_of_ratings,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_ratings
FROM per_rating;
